fail_closed.RIDES-BUS+DAEMON: daemon is a liability with a self-healing tax; not a GEM
fail_closed.SECOND RUNTIME: adopting a mechanism, never a second orchestration runtime

bus_fit.question: Does it ride the existing bus, or demand a second runtime?

irreplaceability.pass: irreplaceable is true AND rename_of_existing is false
irreplaceability.question: Is the mechanism irreplaceable here, or a rename of something already owned?

leverage.question: Leverage per unit of integration cost

measured_evidence.note: E3 (single source / no baseline) may not promote a mechanism. A headline number without its baseline is E3.
measured_evidence.pass: evidence_tier in {E1, E2} AND has_baseline is true AND has_effect_size is true
measured_evidence.question: Is there measured evidence with a baseline, or only a headline?

gem_rule: A mechanism is a GEM if and only if gates L, I, E, and B all pass. The conjunction is the definition; no axis may be waived after seeing grades.
protocol: Publish this document and its sha256 BEFORE loading call-sheet grades. The scorer may read only the feature card. A perfect match against the existing Tier-1 labels is suspicious, not reassuring.
title: Operational GEM criteria (leverage, irreplaceability, measured evidence, bus-fit)
